title: GlassBox Feedback Record
description: One line of runs/feedback.jsonl: an analyst or business-user verdict on one driver from one run, written by engine/feedback.py::record(). Append-only, like the audit log (schemas/findings.schema.json's sibling, runs/audit.jsonl) it is designed to sit next to. This schema is separate from and does not modify findings.schema.json, contract.schema.json or injection_manifest.schema.json - those three are frozen per PROJECT_RULES.md rule 1.

feedback_id.description: ULID. This append-only record's own key, independent of run_id.

run_id.description: The findings object / runs/audit.jsonl record this feedback is about.

driver_id.description: The specific driver within that run's outcome.answer.drivers[] being judged. Only meaningful together with run_id - the same driver_id string can name an unrelated driver under a different run's KPI.

verdict.description: confirmed: the driver was right. rejected: it was wrong - a false positive. partial: right branch, imprecise (e.g. broader segment than the true cause).

note.description: Free-text reason. May be empty, never required to be non-empty - a bare verdict is still real feedback.

reviewer.description: Who gave the verdict. Deliberately looser than findings.schema.json's principal object - a reviewer is not always the same principal who asked the original question.
